title: 第五百八十三章 战争结束后的商机第五百八十二章 金字塔病房
content_zh:
第五百八十三章战争结束后的商机
守护者的死亡，对葬魂位面的土著影响很大。
这意味着它们再也无法通过守护者与位面意志沟通，获得位面意志的帮助。
“碰巧？”林彩环黛眉轻皱，对赵健的问答有些不满，她可不会相信这种病也能碰巧。
众人的目光一下全部聚集在秦越身上，秦越也是十分好奇，杨雅清叫自己是有什么事情吗？
但是在何燕这里彭鹏还是吃了无数的闭门羹，还好何燕有类似魅惑一样的手段。不然的话，彭鹏早就霸王硬上弓了。
“坐吧。”阿宸放开她，坐在对面，却不知被阿宸捉来，硬逼着她吃饭。
“我有银卡，想什么时候进就什么时候进，用你管？”富家公子冷哼一声。
三皇子他看着眼前的这一幕，他的脸上这乃是露出了一个笑容的。
“师父，我，我对不起你，没有帮你报仇！”肖峰不敢直视道言的眼睛，低着头说。
这四人还有一个在断阳那边的，另外六个则是分别跟随蚩烈、吴则、九念而来，都是境界高深实力深厚之辈。
看着张翠山渐渐远去的背影，想起刚才他说的话，沈丽开心得两眼笑成了弯月儿，只是当目光不经意看到张翠山手中提的东西时，不禁有些怅然所失。
陆宣闭上了双眼，将这落英剑法过了一遍，却不急着去参悟，而是继续闭目沉思。
胡唐的家倒是很简单，就是一个茅草房子，外面加上一个六米见方的院子，院子中没有其他的东西，只有一个水缸。
当张烨看到卡牌上面的讯息之后，原本黑下来的脸终于有了一丝反应。
天澜弘是天澜府十大真仙之首，实力已经达到真仙圆满，半只脚踏入了金仙，跺一跺脚，整个澜洲也得抖三抖，所以天澜弘出马，飘渺峰必然只能像野狗一般被驱赶出境了。
“林飞？教官叫你呢！”还是在那艘飞往沪海安全基地的飞船上，冥拉了拉林飞的胳膊，提醒道。
至于其他，暗暗果实，四大赫子，雷神之力，各种皮肤！都只能是辅助攻击。
情况一下子变发了惊天逆转，前一刻，叶风还被压在九重魔山的下面，瞬息之间，不仅脱困而出，而且还成功灭杀了强敌。
只要叶磊能高兴，戚凝做什么都可以，而只要戚凝高兴，叶磊也是什么都可以接受。

谁知那人不顾右手被擒，“咔嚓”一声，竟然硬生生把自己的右臂拗断，一头再向韩萧撞来。
所以，真的和玄甲门那个家伙交手，还是要注意一下周围的环境的。
第五百八十三章战争结束后的商机
“你……”乔三爷刚想大骂，感觉全身一阵抽搐阴寒，并且由于黑暗之力的影响，乔三爷隐隐约约仿佛看见一团黑色的鬼魂在自己面前飘浮。
莫晓生轻轻舒了一口气，轻轻抚摸着手中的残旗，用力让自己不要把悲伤感染其他人。他虽然知道，只要扛起枪，投身到抗日的战场上，鲜血就随时会洒在这片沃土，生命随时会献给祖国。
他也感受到了兽族的一支赤焰虎族的队伍找到了一处上古神兽白虎的一处巢穴，至于他们在里面获得了怎样的宝物就不得而知了。
当然，也有可能自己没有将自己将要离开的消息告诉父母和弟弟的原因，他们还在筹划当中，又或者是自己的弟弟放弃了谋害自己的打算。
“好吧，那先让人家姑娘到一边等着吧。”柴桦对这个谈判结果还是比较接受的。
矮胖子方头大脸三个下巴，浓眉大眼翻嘴唇，没有寻常胖子那种呆萌的感觉，反而给人一种凶恶的感觉。
凌雅轻轻的呼了一口气，此时拍卖的总金额已经达到了十五亿，距离易枫所说的百亿还有很大的距离。
“济南天桥的，不知道将来能不能在一起干点事儿。”柴桦心里默默打算着。
不过看他笑呵呵的样子，对于黑龙族族人的表现丝毫不感到丢人。
然而下一霎，所有人都是傻眼了，那飞过来的圆润珠子竟然发生了爆炸。
房檐下的雨珠总要凝了一阵子才慢悠悠地往下落。风雨停歇，雷鸣电闪到了这会子都收了。皎润洁净的圆月不知何时挂在对面半山腰的百年松树上。山腰上的百年松树剧烈摇舞着。
于丹青微怔，忙道，“请进来。”同时将信件全部收好，放到一旁压着。
刘紫月低头反复念了两遍，似是悟出了什么，面色微变，让奶娘将她怀里的晨哥儿抱下去，仔细地观察起盒中的点心。
“多叫几下，连续叫上三分钟，我保证你能习惯，来，叫吧。”林老大端起水杯，头也不抬。
他明白，没人在乎他的死活，在旁人眼中，自己是个朝廷大员同尼姑私通的孩子，若不是自己，或者说，若是不是自己的生母，韩家就不会落得旁人笑话。
如今自己怎么说也是皇上身边最亲近的人，皇后娘娘即便是被人控制了，现在也只有她们两人有此感觉，更是应该要互通消息，只要她们一条心，才能助皇上走出困境才是，皇后娘娘肯定是会见她的。

Chapter 583: Business opportunities after the war
The death of the guardian has a great impact on the natives of the Soul Burial Plane.
This means that they can no longer communicate with the will of the plane through the guardian and receive help from the will of the plane.
"A coincidence?" Lin Caihuan frowned slightly, a little dissatisfied with Zhao Jian's question and answer. She would not believe that this disease could happen by chance.
Everyone's eyes suddenly focused on Qin Yue. Qin Yue was also very curious. Did Yang Yaqing call him something?
But Peng Peng still received countless rejections from He Yan. Fortunately, He Yan had a method similar to charm. Otherwise, Peng Peng would have taken advantage of him long ago.
"Sit down." A-Chen let her go and sat across from her. Unexpectedly, A-Chen caught her and forced her to eat.
"I have a silver card. I can come in whenever I want. Is it up to you to control it?" The rich man snorted coldly.
The third prince looked at the scene in front of him with a smile on his face.
"Master, I, I'm sorry for you, I didn't help you get revenge!" Xiao Feng did not dare to look directly into Dao Yan's eyes and said with his head lowered.
One of these four people is on Duanyang's side, and the other six came with Chi Lie, Wu Ze, and Jiu Nian respectively. They are all people with advanced realms and profound strength.
Looking at Zhang Cuishan's retreating back, and remembering what he said just now, Shen Li was so happy that her eyes turned into crescent moons, but when she accidentally saw the thing in Zhang Cuishan's hand, she couldn't help but feel a little disappointed.
Lu Xuan closed his eyes and went through the Luoying Sword Technique again, but he was not in a hurry to understand it, but continued to close his eyes and meditate.
Hu Tang's home is very simple, just a thatched house with a six-meter-square yard outside. There is nothing else in the yard except a water tank.
When Zhang Ye saw the message on the card, his darkened face finally showed some reaction.
Tian Lanhong is the first of the ten true immortals in Tianlan Mansion, and his strength has reached the perfection of true immortals. Half of his feet have stepped into the Golden Immortal. Stamping his feet makes the entire Lanzhou tremble. Therefore, if Tian Lanhong takes action, Piaomiao Peak will inevitably be driven out like a wild dog.
"Lin Fei? The instructor is calling you!" Still on the spaceship flying to the Shanghai Safety Base, Ming pulled Lin Fei's arm and reminded him.
As for the others, the Dark Fruit, the Four Great Hezis, the Power of the God of Thunder, and various skins! They can only be auxiliary attacks.
The situation suddenly took a shocking turn. A moment ago, Ye Feng was pinned under the Nine Layers of the Demonic Mountain. In an instant, he not only escaped from the trap, but also successfully killed the powerful enemy.
As long as Ye Lei is happy, Qi Ning can do anything, and as long as Qi Ning is happy, Ye Lei can accept anything.
Unexpectedly, the man ignored the fact that his right hand was captured, and with a "click", he broke off his right arm forcefully, and then bumped into Han Xiao.
Therefore, if you really fight against that guy from Xuanjiamen, you still have to pay attention to your surroundings.
Chapter 583: Business opportunities after the war
"You..." Mr. Qiao was just about to curse when he felt a twitching chill all over his body. And due to the influence of the power of darkness, Mr. Qiao vaguely seemed to see a black ghost floating in front of him.
Mo Xiaosheng breathed a sigh of relief and gently stroked the broken flag in his hand, trying hard not to infect others with his sadness. Although he knew that as long as he picked up the gun and devoted himself to the anti-Japanese battlefield, blood would be spilled on this fertile soil at any time, and his life would be dedicated to the motherland at any time.
He also felt that a team of the Red Flame Tiger Clan of the Orc Clan had found a lair of the ancient divine beast White Tiger. It was unknown what treasures they obtained inside.
Of course, it's also possible that he didn't tell his parents and younger brother that he was leaving because they were still planning, or that his younger brother gave up on his plan to murder her.
"Okay, let's let the girl wait aside first." ChaiHua is quite accepting of the negotiation result.
The short fat man has a square head, a big face, three chins, thick eyebrows, big eyes, and turned lips. He does not have the cute look of an ordinary fat man, but instead gives people a vicious feeling.
Ling Ya breathed out softly. At this time, the total amount of the auction had reached 1.5 billion, which was still far away from the tens of billions mentioned by Yi Feng.
"We from Jinan Tianqiao, I wonder if we can do something together in the future." Chai Hua silently planned in his mind.
But looking at the way he was smiling, he didn't feel embarrassed at all about the behavior of the Black Dragon clan members.
However, the next moment, everyone was dumbfounded. The round beads flying over actually exploded.
The raindrops under the eaves always condensed for a while before falling slowly. The wind and rain stopped, and the thunder and lightning stopped for a while. The bright and clean full moon was unknown when it hung on the centuries-old pine trees on the opposite mountainside. The century-old pine trees on the mountainside were swaying violently.
Yu Danqing was slightly startled and said hurriedly, "Please come in." At the same time, he put all the letters away and put them aside.
Liu Ziyue lowered her head and recited it twice. She seemed to have realized something, her face changed slightly, and she asked the wet nurse to take Brother Chen down from her arms and carefully observe the snacks in the box.
"Bow a few more times, keep shouting for three minutes, and I guarantee you'll get used to it. Come on, shout." Boss Lin picked up the water glass without raising his head.
He understood that no one cared about his life or death. In the eyes of others, he was the child of a court official having an affair with a nun. If it hadn't been for him, or in other words, if it hadn't been for his biological mother, the Han family would not have been laughed at by others.
Now, I am the closest person to the emperor. Even if the empress is controlled by someone, only the two of them feel this way now. They should exchange news. As long as they work together, they can help the emperor get out of the predicament. The empress will definitely meet her.
